text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"My fangs couldn't reach the front... The 
fangs I've sharpened until today."

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
There's no point in hunting someone who 
doesn't put up a fight...!
choice_data_list:
The tougher they are, the more fired up I 
get!

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text: Yeah, now this is getting interesting.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Just one more step. If only I could press 
in one step further—

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
"...Alright. Next time, I'll definitely 
keep up!"

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
What is needed, huh? In other words, the 
areas where we're currently lacking.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
...It's just a hunch, but I think the 
answer is already clear. Same for you, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Then that settles it. We just need to 
train that thoroughly.

text_block_list.name: Narita Brian
text_block_list.text:
Let's go. We're raising the smoke signal 
for our counterattack...!
